page.layout: One page of text, set in one column. Running head at top, with the title "IEREMIÆ." left of centre and page number 19 at top right. Under the running head, an italic motto line above a rule. Centred acrostic heading "PE. HAIM. TSADI." Then verse stanzas, indented alternately. Signature "B ij" at the foot right. No margin notes.
page.running_head: IEREMIÆ. Fama ausa est magis urbibus unam.

p.i: Te sannis petit asperis, Exultatque tuis cladibus insolens Victor Barbarus, & truci Frendens dente ferox talia sibilis Miscet verba procacibus.
Nunc omnis Solymæ gloria funditus Nostro concidit impetu.
Nunc votis fruimur, grata nitet dies: Qua tandem Abramidum licet Nostro colla iugo subdita cernere
Sic, quas Lege Deus sacra Descripsit superis temporibus minas Implet. Sic meritum luit Fœdis supplicium criminibus Syon:
Nunc tandem immiserabilis Cœlesti cadit, heu! vindice dextera Qua savis[?] fauet hostibus:
Atque auctos variis mulcet honoribus. Hinc rident Solymæ mala Inflati tumido pectora gaudio.
At pressi Abramidæ petunt Incassum querulis æthera vocibus.

page.notes: The signature at the foot right is read as "B" followed by a mark that may be "ij" or "2"; doubtful. "Qua savis fauet" reads as "sauis" in the scan; the æ is uncertain, so the word is marked. The underlined "Qua" and the decorative initials of the stanzas are left as printed in the verse. Stanza divisions follow sentence breaks, since the indentation alone does not show them. Show-through from the reverse is ignored.
